note: Endorsements from people who do not vote in the Senate Democratic leader election. They are not part of any count on this page. Curated by hand; there is no script for this file.

items.identity: Believed to be Erica Deuso, mayor of Downingtown, Pennsylvania (in office since January 5, 2026, per Wikipedia). The site maintainer identified the account; no page we could read links this Threads handle to Ms. Deuso, so the match is not independently confirmed.
items.quote: I am unequivocally endorsing Senator Chris Van Hollen to become the next Senate Majority Leader and calling on Senator Chuck Schumer to step aside.
items.date_note: Date is approximate: the post was shown as 20 hours old in a screenshot taken on November 27.
items.how_read: The link was supplied by the site maintainer. Scripts cannot open Threads, so the quote was read from the maintainer's screenshot of the post (first of three posts in the thread), not checked by script.
